title: How to Launch Enterprise Crypto Services in Days, Not Months
summary: Discover how SFOX Connect simplifies institutional digital asset integration. Launch trading, secure custody, and compliant banking rails in just days, not months.
body_markdown:
For banks, fintechs, and asset managers, the demand for digital assets is impossible to ignore. However, building a secure, compliant crypto ecosystem from scratch typically requires navigating fragmented vendors, immense regulatory hurdles, and ballooning development costs.


**sFOX Connect** changes the paradigm. As a single-integration infrastructure layer, it allows enterprises to embed institutional-grade crypto capabilities directly into their existing systems in days, not months.


### [Connect Overview Brochure 4](https://www.sfox.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Connect-Overview-Brochure-4.pdf)


### Comprehensive Capabilities through a Single Connection


Instead of managing multiple vendor relationships, sFOX Connect consolidates the vital components of a mature digital asset offering into a unified API suite


:


-


**Advanced Market Execution:** Access centralized liquidity with smart routing designed to minimize market impact and slippage


.


-


**Regulated Custody:** Protect user assets via a secure, SOC 2-aligned, Wyoming Trust-regulated framework that permits trading directly from safekeeping


.


-


**Embedded Compliance:** Automate user onboarding with built-in KYC, KYB, AML screening, and audit-ready institutional reporting


.


- **Global Fiat Rails:** Move capital seamlessly with streamlined, international crypto-to-fiat and fiat-to-crypto payment pipelines.


Versatile Use Cases for Modern Finance


sFOX Connect runs quietly in the background, allowing you to focus on your user experience while scaling diverse financial products


:


-


**Wealth Management:** Build custom trading desks, automated portfolios, or prime brokerage services


.


-


**Global Payments & Lending:** Power borderless stablecoin settlements, real-time B2B invoicing, and crypto-backed credit.


-


**Next-Gen Commerce:** Drive engagement through corporate treasury management and crypto rewards programs.


> **A Proven Partner:** Since 2014, sFOX has provided institutional crypto liquidity across various market cycles. sFOX Connect brings that battle-tested foundation to your platform with customizable fee structures and concierge support.
